nodes.author: sai_ramana_1999
nodes.text:
Here's some precautions to consider:

Practice Good Hygiene: Wash your hands frequently with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, or use hand sanitizer when soap is unavailable.

Avoid Close Contact: Keep a safe distance from individuals showing symptoms of respiratory illness

nodes.author: sai_ramana_1999
nodes.text:
Wear Masks: In crowded places or during outbreaks, wearing a mask can help reduce the risk of transmission.

Disinfect Surfaces: Regularly clean high-touch surfaces such as doorknobs, phones, and countertops to minimize contamination.

nodes.author: sai_ramana_1999
nodes.text:
Monitor Symptoms: Be aware of common symptoms like cough, fever, nasal congestion, and shortness of breath. Seek medical attention if symptoms worsen or persist.

Stay Informed* Follow updates from health authorities and adhere to any advisories issued by local health departments
